notes: A new home screen made for the controller: the sidebar is gone. Deckhand opens on six big cards (Start, Install, Stores, Stream, Add-ons, Installed); move with the D-pad, A opens one, B brings you back. Text boxes open Steam's own keyboard in Game Mode, L1/R1 page through long lists, and programs started from Deckhand no longer print Steam overlay errors. Add-on downloads must match their published checksum (Nexus, Arcadia, GE-Proton) and are logged. RetroDECK is no longer offered: Arcadia covers retro games.
